_what: How a request template becomes a request (do-work/request-scopes.mjs). `open` and `close` bracket a placeholder. `scope_order` is the default order of scope names, first holding a value wins; a caller may give its own ordered list. Secrets are always the last scope, so no ordinary variable can hide one. `mask` replaces a secret's value in anything kept or shown. A new delimiter, order or word is a row here.

words.secret_host_unbound: The secret {name} is bound to {hosts} and the request goes to {host}, so it was not placed.
words.secret_url_unreadable: The secret {name} was not placed: the request's address could not be read as one host.
words.secret_moved_host: The secret {name} was not placed: placing it would change where the request goes.
